what_it_establishes: Notice takes effect on the seventh day of publication. Certified mail is used in addition where an address is held.
operational_note: Runs whether or not an addressee has been identified.

lapse_consequence: Silence past this date hands the removal to the delegated agency.
what_it_establishes: The addressee states whether they will carry out the removal or have the agency do it.
operational_note: Commits a route. Execution is the next step.

step_name: Removal carried out by the addressee
what_it_establishes: Removal by mechanical means. Foliage destroyed on site; timber remains with the addressee.
operational_note: One of three alternative routes at this step. Applies where the addressee elected to act.

step_name: Removal carried out by the delegated agency
what_it_establishes: The agency performs the removal where the addressee elected it.
operational_note: One of three alternative routes at this step. Applies where the addressee elected the agency.

step_name: Removal by the agency after no election
what_it_establishes: Silence past the election deadline routes the work to the agency of its own motion.
operational_note: One of three alternative routes at this step. Applies where no election was recorded.

what_it_establishes: The agency removes by force, informs the Prefect and the police, and charges the cost to the addressee.
operational_note: Runs only where a refusal has been recorded.

what_it_establishes: Voluntary work is checked by inspectors or agents of the authority; agency work is checked by two of the agency's own plant-health assistants.

step_name: Official record of removal and destruction
what_it_establishes: A plant-health official presides over the removal and destruction and writes the official record, which is what a later claim for compensation rests on.
